links.outcome: Readability of GPT-4o answers for relatives (FRE, FKG, Gunning Fog)
links.effect: FRE 7.23, Flesch-Kincaid grade 15.87 and Gunning Fog index 18.15, indicating very difficult, college-graduate-level text unsuited to lay relatives.
links.quote: The readability assessment revealed an FRE score of 7.23, an FKG score of 15.87 and a GF index of 18.15.

links.outcome: Whether GPT-4o responses supplied sources for its claims
links.effect: GPT-4o did not systematically provide references; sourcing was among the poorest-scoring QAMAI categories, so users cannot trace claims.
links.quote: GPT-4o did not systematically provide references for their responses.

screen.reason: Evaluates GPT-4o's baseline quality and readability for answering relatives' clinical questions without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment intervention.
